changes: Copies show source, codec, audio, language and channel; cam and PreDVD copies stay hidden unless you allow them in Settings
The series guide and versions now gather every copy and episode from all your selected chats
Titles without a sure match show a scene from the video itself instead of a wrong cover
Home opens faster, and the banner now rotates ten titles and names each one's OTT platform
Player: a Go Live button appears when you fall behind a live stream, and the next episode starts in place with a 10 second countdown
Downloads resume under their proper names, space errors say how much is needed and how much is free, and a stalled download restarts itself
Search results are wide Netflix-style rows, and you can pull down to refresh a search
A full Profile page: your account, My List, backup and restore, and a weekly automatic backup to a folder you pick
Trailers play inside the app first, finished downloads say Downloaded, and the Live row also sits under J MOVIES in the Chats list
What's New now shows the changes from the update feed itself
